title: One woman we remember with love
intro: Today we remember one woman from Sardinia. We share only what trusted sources have told us, and we hold her in our thoughts with gratitude.

women.name: Rimedia Cocco
tribute: Rimedia Cocco, 78, from Nule in Sardinia, is remembered by her community as devoted, very altruistic and a respected point of reference for everyone who knew her.
women.example: Her life shows how quiet devotion to others can become a point of reference for a whole village.
